note: camera stability, the way a person plays: one pad through title, join and start, then stand, walk, stop, jump and stand while the drawn camera is measured every frame (g.camgate: frames at rest, at-rest frames that moved over 1 mm, frames in motion, frames in motion with a jump over 0.6 m or a jerk over 8 cm). At rest it must not move at all; in motion it must stay smooth.
